meta.title: Institutions
meta.description: Check and decide on institution registrations.

adminInstitutions.title: Institutions
adminInstitutions.lead: Check each registration, then verify, reject or suspend it. Every decision needs a reason, which the institution's authorised person sees.

forbidden.title: Only FOA admins can see this
forbidden.body: Ask a super admin for the staff admin role if you need it.

meta.title: Check an institution
meta.description: Every detail of one institution's registration, and its decision.

notFound.title: No institution with that link
notFound.body: It may have been typed wrongly. Go back to the list to find it.

review.noDecision: There is nothing more to decide: a registration that wasn't accepted stays that way. The person can register again.

reason.label: Reason
reason.hint: The authorised person sees this. Up to {max} characters.
reason.required: Write a reason for this decision.

decided.verified: Verified. The institution's ID is {code}, and its authorised person is now its admin.
decided.rejected: Rejected. The authorised person will be told why.
decided.suspended: Suspended. The authorised person will be told why.
decided.reinstated: Verified again. The institution keeps its ID.

alerts.transition_not_allowed: That decision isn't possible any more: someone else may have decided first. The page now shows the current status.
alerts.unexpected: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a few minutes.
